description:
Commercial auto, step 1 of 2: call it until ready_to_submit is true, sending back the collected it returns each time and each answer under answer_as.key. Then submit_commercial_application.

For a vehicle a business owns or uses for its work: a contractor's pickup, a delivery van, a box truck, a tow truck, a fleet. It takes the short intake Sigo's commercial form opens with, one question at a time in the customer's language, and a Sigo agent quotes it with the carriers afterwards. There is no estimate and no price here, and none to give: say any quote is subject to underwriting, eligibility and state filing.

Its first question tells a business apart from someone who drives only for Uber, Lyft, DoorDash or Uber Eats. That is personal auto: route_to_personal turns true, nothing commercial is sent, and next_question takes it from there. When it is not clear which kind of customer this is, start here.

Ask `ask` as the website words it, with its options, and wait for the answer. It never asks for a social security number, a FEIN or EIN, a date of birth or a licence number; do not collect them.

answered.description: Only what the customer said this turn, under answer_as.key. Everything earlier is in `collected`.

business_state.description: The state the business's physical address is in: its two-letter code (TX) or its name in English or Spanish (Texas, Nuevo México).

business_type_other.description: Only when business_type is `other`: what the business does, in the customer's words.

phone.description: A US number, as the customer gave it.

vehicle_use.description: The first question: apps only, or a business.

collected.description: The `collected` from the previous call. Leave it out on the first question and send it on every call after that. It is not the quote flow's collected: the two do not mix.

locale.description: The language the customer is writing in. Set it from their own messages: the questions come back in it, and the request is filed in it so the Sigo agent follows up in it.

name: commercial_next_question

key.description: The exact key to send this answer under in `answered` on the next call.

values.description: For `enum`: the only values accepted. values[i] is what options[i] means.

answer_as.description: How to send the answer back. Null once nothing is left to ask.

ask.description: The website's own wording of the question, in the customer's language. Put it to them as it is; do not reword the options.

collected.description: Everything answered so far, this turn included. Send it back on the next call.

field.description: The question being asked, by name; `none` when there is nothing left to ask.

tool.description: The tool to call next, when there is one.

next_step.description: Present when the intake ends: what to call next.

options.description: Every choice the customer may pick, when the question has a fixed set, in answer_as.values order.

ready_to_submit.description: True when every question is answered: read the summary back, then submit_commercial_application.

route_to_personal.description: True when the customer drives only for apps: that is personal auto, nothing commercial is sent, and next_question takes it from here.

summary.description: What the customer answered, to read back before submitting. Only when ready_to_submit is true.

title: The next commercial auto question to ask a business
